title: Sync upstream main: Edit In external editors, Speed Edit and the HSL-stage color mixer pipette
highlight: Edit In sends a photo to an external editor and brings the result back, Speed Edit cycles sliders from the keyboard, and the Color Mixer pipette now also edits mask mixers.
notes: Upstream's mixer pipette (sampled at the HSL stage by a backend probe pass) replaces RapidRoom's harvested copy of the same feature; RapidRoom's extras are ported onto it: the pipette ends when the image changes, the window loses focus or the Color/Color Mixer tool is bypassed, a focused slider field is committed before a drag, an unmoved press writes no edit, and the pipette turns off when the Color panel unmounts. The old display-texture sampler is removed. RapidRoom's mask/perf-trace spans and Lightroom adjustment-key attributes are kept, as are its keybinding priority, Instagram export entries and the headless export error report. Locale catalogs are upstream's byte for byte. The probe is a separate compute pass and does not change rendered output.
